title: The Top 4 ETF Strategies for New Investors
author: Dana George
description: The article outlines four ETF strategies for new investors: dollar-cost averaging to minimize market volatility, core and satellite portfolio building to balance steady growth with higher-risk investments, international diversification to capture opportunities outside the U.S., and dividend ETFs for income generation. ETFs are highlighted as offering diversification, low fees, tax efficiency, and liquidity for beginning investors.

title: 3 Dividend ETFs with 25% Upside Over the Next Year, According to Wall Street Analysts
author: David Dierking
description: Three dividend ETFs are positioned for significant upside potential of approximately 25% over the next year, driven by market rotation into value stocks and tech exposure. The ProShares S&P Technology Dividend Aristocrats ETF (TDV), Capital Group Dividend Value ETF (CGDV), and WisdomTree U.S. Quality Dividend Growth ETF (DGRW) all feature substantial technology sector allocations with analyst price targets suggesting strong growth potential despite their dividend-focused strategies.
